# Internal benchmark execution foundation

The exact Node 26.13.0 benchmark context, benchmark/suite tree, harness, result stream and run algorithms are staged unchanged under `upstream/testing`. The existing testing factory can require `internal/bench_runner/harness` and `internal/bench_runner/runner`; their actual consumers create real AsyncResources/ALS state, capture `process.hrtime.bigint`, execute hooks/warmup/measured callbacks, enforce context method contracts/cancellation, summarize real samples through the histogram owner, and publish structured record streams with backpressure. The ordinary `--bench` option default derives from the pinned native `bench_runner` field. No alternate numeric clock, generated timings, host production execution or successful empty stream is supplied.

This is an internal execution prerequisite, not public `node:bench` activation. The public entry module, `node:bench/reporters`, experimental warning/flag ownership, CLI file discovery/import, process isolation and IPC remain unimplemented. Existing public `node:test` exposure is unchanged. A later activation must consume the actual owner and resolve its remaining dependencies; adding a flag alone is insufficient.

The unchanged Error record repair module consumes the actual current V8 owner lazily. That owner still lacks serialize/deserialize. There is no fabricated byte format or replacement serializer. A named TypeError record with custom name/code/cause loses its required metadata with the current V8 owner; that is an implementation nonpass, not an accepted platform exclusion. The native serializer used by the positive component fixture is an explicit dependency and must not be credited as guest implementation.

Focused source components compare recorded sample/hook/warmup/done/detail-isolation/statistics, genuine positive monotonic timing and invalid/expired context behavior with the pinned native owner. A separate named-error comparison distinguishes the real native dependency from the current missing V8 serializer. No normal core generation, engine compilation, guest execution, public activation or four-host conformance was performed.
